controlled_source_difference_confirmed.description: V9.3/V10.6 differ ONLY in radius-3 near/far crop siting. All economic targets, seed quantities, animal gates, labor rules, fertilizer rules, land rules, selling, routing, and opponent observation code are byte-identical between the two policies (per V2_3F audit, re-confirmed by direct inspection of animal_maintenance_action and the SELL dispatch code in V10.6's source).

seams_considered.reason: Identical territory to V2_3I (production-event-aware fertilizer scheduling / in-transit target ordering). V2_3I froze a real trace-derived bound (24 missed events seed 920, $4,896 upper bound / $67,932 across 16 seeds) and lost the seed-920 gate by -$9,686. Re-testing under a new name would violate the do-not-retest instruction.

animal_maintenance_action / _pasture_priority code is byte-identical between V9.3 and V10.6 (confirmed by audit statement and direct source inspection). MILK +103 / WOOL -73 sale deltas are downstream consequences of siting-driven worker-position and crop-mix shifts, not a distinct collection-order rule differing between the two policies. A new rule here would be a hindsight-fitted heuristic on already-closed service/routing territory (V2_3G/V2_3H/V2_3R), not a cross-policy-derived mechanism.

market_price / _sell_priority / SELL dispatch code is byte-identical between V9.3 and V10.6. The sale-mix shift (995 more MELON, 292 more CARROT, 424 more FERTILIZER, 103 more MILK sold; 501 fewer STRAWBERRY, 415 fewer TOMATO) is fully explained as a consequence of the crop-mix shift caused by siting, with no independently controllable sales-timing rule identifiable.
V2_3L tested this directly with a real trace gate and found no completable-harvest opportunity from delaying/reordering plantings; classified LOW_VALUE, no candidate built.
V2_3H already tested and rejected this exact mechanism family.

bound.reason: No seam qualified as a genuinely separate, non-rejected, non-hindsight-fitted mechanism, so Phase 2 (bound computation) was not entered. The only directly relevant real bound on record is V2_3I's ($4,896 seed-920 upper bound / $67,932 across 16 seeds), which was tested and resulted in a -$9,686 loss on seed 920 -- reinforcing closure of that seam rather than leaving it open.
